name: Henotheism
overview: The Bible reveals that while other gods are acknowledged in human understanding, the LORD is supreme above all, as seen in Exodus 18:11 and Psalms 86:8. The unity and deity of God are affirmed in John 1:1, emphasizing that the Word was both with God and was God. Although some may believe in the existence of other gods, James 2:19 clarifies that true faith is in the one true God alone. This affirms a clear monotheistic foundation, countering any notion of henotheism where one god is elevated among many.
